name: Collect Coal
rationale: Coal is essential fuel for smelting and making torches.
actual: Find and mine coal ore from caves or exposed stone areas.

plan.action_nl: Collect oak logs, craft planks, a crafting table, sticks, and a wooden pickaxe.
plan.notes: Coal ore requires a pickaxe (any tier) to yield a drop; mining it by hand yields nothing.

plan.action_nl: Search for coal ore in caves or exposed stone faces
plan.notes: Coal ore appears at similar heights to iron ore, commonly in caves.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 8 coal ore blocks using the wooden pickaxe
plan.expected: At least 8 coal items in inventory.
plan.notes: Coal ore requires a pickaxe (any tier) to drop coal — mining by hand yields nothing.

name: Collect Iron Ore
rationale: Iron is a versatile material used for tools, armor, and many crafting recipes.
actual: Find and mine iron ore from underground areas using a stone pickaxe.

plan.action_nl: Collect wood, craft a wooden pickaxe, mine stone, and craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Iron requires at least a stone pickaxe to mine. We craft one from scratch.

plan.action_nl: Search underground (below Y=64) for iron ore deposits
plan.notes: Iron ore is most common below Y=64.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 3 iron ore blocks using stone pickaxe or better
plan.expected: At least 3 raw iron in inventory.
plan.notes: Mining iron_ore drops raw_iron in Minecraft 1.17+. Always bring extra torches when cave mining.

name: Collect Wood
rationale: Wood is a fundamental resource used for tools, building, and fuel.
actual: Find trees and collect logs by breaking them with your hand or any tool.

plan.action_nl: Look for nearby trees (oak, birch, spruce, etc.)
plan.notes: Different biomes have different tree types.

plan.action_nl: Break at least 4 log blocks from trees
plan.notes: An axe makes this faster but is not required.

name: Collect Cobblestone
rationale: Cobblestone is essential for crafting tools, furnaces, and building.
actual: Mine stone blocks to obtain cobblestone.

plan.action_nl: You need at least a wooden pickaxe to mine stone
plan.notes: The wooden pickaxe is only for mining stone, not durable.

plan.action_nl: Look for exposed stone or dig down to reach stone layer
plan.notes: Stone is typically just below the dirt layer.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 8 stone blocks to get cobblestone
plan.notes: Mining stone always yields cobblestone (not smooth stone).

name: Collect Sand
rationale: Sand is used for crafting glass, sandstone, and concrete.
actual: Find sand near water or in deserts and collect it by hand or with a shovel.

plan.action_nl: Search for sand blocks near water, beaches, or in desert biomes.
plan.notes: Sand is found near water bodies and in desert biomes.

plan.action_nl: Collect at least 8 sand blocks.
plan.notes: Sand can be collected by hand, but a shovel is much faster.

name: Collect Gold Ore
rationale: Gold is used for powered rails, golden apples, and trading with piglins. Requires iron pickaxe to mine.
actual: Craft an iron pickaxe, then find and mine gold ore underground or in mesas.

plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft sticks, mine cobblestone, and craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Gold ore requires iron pickaxe, so we first need stone pickaxe to get iron.

plan.goal: Mine iron and craft iron pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Mine iron ore with stone pickaxe, smelt into ingots, and craft an iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Iron pickaxe is the minimum tool required to mine gold ore.

plan.action_nl: Search underground or in mesa biomes for gold ore deposits.
plan.notes: Gold ore spawns between Y=-64 and Y=32, more common in mesa biomes.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 3 gold ore blocks using iron pickaxe.
plan.expected: At least 3 raw gold in inventory.
plan.notes: Mining gold_ore drops raw_gold in Minecraft 1.17+. Must use iron pickaxe or better.

name: Collect Lapis Lazuli
rationale: Lapis lazuli is used for enchanting and blue dye. Requires stone pickaxe to mine.
actual: Craft a stone pickaxe, then find and mine lapis ore deep underground.

plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft sticks, mine cobblestone, and craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Lapis ore requires stone pickaxe or better to mine.

plan.action_nl: Search deep underground for lapis lazuli ore.
plan.notes: Lapis ore spawns deep underground, usually below Y=0.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 6 lapis ore blocks using stone pickaxe or better.
plan.expected: At least 6 lapis lazuli in inventory.
plan.notes: Each lapis ore drops 4-9 lapis lazuli. Very valuable for enchanting.

name: Collect Redstone Dust
rationale: Redstone is essential for circuits, mechanisms, and powered devices. Requires iron pickaxe to mine — stone pickaxe cannot break redstone ore.
actual: Craft an iron pickaxe, then find and mine redstone ore deep underground.

plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft sticks, mine cobblestone, and craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Stone pickaxe is needed to mine iron ore. Redstone ore itself requires iron pickaxe.

plan.goal: Mine iron ore and craft iron pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Mine iron ore with stone pickaxe, smelt into ingots, and craft an iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Iron pickaxe is the minimum tool required to mine redstone ore in Minecraft 1.20.4.

plan.action_nl: Search deep underground for redstone ore deposits.
plan.notes: Redstone ore spawns below Y=16 and emits a faint glow when touched.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 8 redstone ore blocks using iron pickaxe.
plan.expected: At least 8 redstone dust in inventory.
plan.notes: Each redstone ore drops 4-5 redstone dust. Must use iron pickaxe or better.

name: Collect Diamonds
rationale: Diamonds are the most valuable resource for top-tier tools and armor. Requires iron pickaxe to mine.
actual: Craft an iron pickaxe through the full tool chain, then mine diamond ore deep underground.

plan.goal: Craft basic tools and stone pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft crafting table and wooden pickaxe, mine cobblestone, craft stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Diamonds require iron pickaxe, so we need the full chain from scratch.

plan.goal: Mine iron and craft iron pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Mine iron ore with stone pickaxe, smelt into ingots, and craft an iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Iron pickaxe is the minimum tool required to mine diamond ore.

plan.action_nl: Search deep underground (Y < -58) for diamond ore.
plan.notes: Diamonds spawn below Y=-58, often near lava pools.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 3 diamond ore blocks using iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Each diamond ore drops exactly 1 diamond. Must use iron pickaxe or better.

name: Collect Copper Ore
rationale: Copper is used for lightning rods, spyglasses, and building blocks. Requires stone pickaxe to mine.
actual: Craft a stone pickaxe, then find and mine copper ore underground.

plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft sticks, mine cobblestone, and craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Copper ore requires stone pickaxe or better to mine.

plan.action_nl: Search underground for copper ore deposits.
plan.notes: Copper ore is common between Y=0 and Y=96.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 5 copper ore blocks using stone pickaxe or better.
plan.expected: At least 5 raw copper in inventory.
plan.notes: Each copper ore drops 2-3 raw copper. Can be smelted into copper ingots.

name: Collect Emeralds
rationale: Emeralds are used for trading with villagers. Rare and requires iron pickaxe to mine.
actual: Craft an iron pickaxe, then find and mine emerald ore in mountain biomes.

plan.goal: Craft basic tools and stone pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft sticks, mine cobblestone, and craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Emerald ore requires iron pickaxe, so we need the full tool chain.

plan.goal: Mine iron and craft iron pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Mine iron ore, smelt into ingots, and craft an iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Iron pickaxe is required to mine emerald ore.

plan.action_nl: Search in mountain biomes for emerald ore.
plan.notes: Emerald ore only spawns in mountain biomes, making it very rare.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 3 emerald ore blocks using iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Each emerald ore drops exactly 1 emerald. Very valuable for villager trading.

name: Collect Iron in Bulk
rationale: Bulk iron collection for large crafting projects like armor sets or anvil.
actual: Craft a stone pickaxe, then mine a large quantity of iron ore underground.

plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft sticks, mine cobblestone, and craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Bring a stone pickaxe for bulk iron mining.

plan.action_nl: Search underground for large iron ore deposits.
plan.notes: Iron ore spawns in veins of up to 9 blocks.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 16 iron ore blocks using stone pickaxe.
plan.expected: At least 16 raw iron in inventory.
plan.notes: Mining iron_ore drops raw_iron in Minecraft 1.17+. Smelt in batches for efficiency.

name: Collect Clay
rationale: Clay is used for bricks, terracotta, and pottery. Found near water.
actual: Find clay blocks near rivers and lakes, then collect them by hand or with a shovel.

plan.action_nl: Search for clay blocks near rivers, lakes, or ocean shores.
plan.notes: Clay is found underwater near sand, appearing as gray-blue blocks.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 16 clay blocks.
plan.expected: At least 16 clay balls in inventory.
plan.notes: Each clay block drops 4 clay balls. Can be smelted into bricks or crafted into terracotta.

name: Collect Cactus
rationale: Cactus is used for green dye and defense. Found only in desert biomes.
actual: Find cactus in desert biomes and collect them by breaking the base block.

plan.action_nl: Search for cactus blocks in desert biomes.
plan.notes: Cactus only grows in desert biomes on sand blocks.

plan.action_nl: Break the base of cactus plants to collect at least 8 cactus blocks.
plan.notes: Breaking the bottom of a tall cactus drops all blocks above it. Touching cactus causes damage.

name: Collect Glowstone
rationale: Glowstone provides bright light and is used in redstone lamps. Found in the Nether.
actual: Find glowstone in the Nether and collect it. No special tool required.

plan.action_nl: Search for glowstone blocks hanging from nether ceilings.
plan.notes: Glowstone generates on the ceilings of the Nether. Any tool works.

plan.action_nl: Break glowstone blocks to collect glowstone dust.
plan.expected: At least 8 glowstone dust in inventory.
plan.notes: Each glowstone block drops 2-4 glowstone dust. Can be crafted back into glowstone blocks.

name: Collect Obsidian
rationale: Obsidian is required for nether portals and enchanting tables. Requires diamond pickaxe to mine.
actual: Craft a diamond pickaxe through the full tool chain, then mine obsidian formed by water touching lava.

plan.goal: Craft basic tools and stone pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft crafting table and wooden pickaxe, mine cobblestone, craft stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Obsidian requires diamond pickaxe. This is the longest tool chain.

plan.goal: Mine iron and craft iron pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Mine iron ore, smelt into ingots, and craft an iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Iron pickaxe needed to mine diamond ore.

plan.goal: Mine diamond and craft diamond pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Mine diamond ore with iron pickaxe, then craft a diamond pickaxe.
plan.notes: Diamond pickaxe is the only tool that can mine obsidian.

plan.action_nl: Search for obsidian formed where water meets lava, or pour water on lava to create obsidian.
plan.notes: Obsidian forms when flowing water touches a lava source block.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 10 obsidian blocks using diamond pickaxe.
plan.notes: Obsidian takes 10 seconds to mine with diamond pickaxe. Do NOT use any other tool — it will drop nothing.

name: Collect Ancient Debris
rationale: Ancient debris is the source of netherite, the strongest material in the game. Extremely rare, found only in the Nether.
actual: Craft a diamond pickaxe through the full tool chain, enter the Nether, and mine ancient debris at Y=8-22.

plan.goal: Craft full tool chain to iron pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft tools through wood and stone tiers, mine iron and smelt, craft iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Ancient debris needs diamond pickaxe, requiring the full overworld tool chain first.

plan.goal: Mine diamond and craft diamond pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Mine diamond ore with iron pickaxe, then craft a diamond pickaxe.
plan.notes: Diamond pickaxe is required to mine ancient debris.

plan.goal: Mine obsidian for the nether portal
plan.action_nl: Mine 10 obsidian blocks using the diamond pickaxe.
plan.notes: Obsidian requires a diamond pickaxe or better to mine — lower tiers yield nothing.

plan.action_nl: Build a nether portal from obsidian and light it with a flint and steel or fire charge.
plan.notes: Need 10 obsidian for a full portal frame. Light with flint and steel to activate.

plan.action_nl: Search in the Nether at Y=8-22 for ancient debris blocks.
plan.notes: Ancient debris is very rare, spawning at Y=8-22 in the Nether. It is blast-resistant.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 2 ancient debris blocks using diamond pickaxe.
plan.expected: At least 2 ancient debris in inventory.
plan.notes: Ancient debris can be smelted into netherite scraps. 4 scraps + 4 gold ingots = 1 netherite ingot.

name: Collect Ender Pearls
rationale: Ender pearls are essential for reaching the End dimension and teleportation. Dropped by endermen.
actual: Prepare iron armor and sword, find an enderman, build shelter, and defeat it to collect ender pearls.

plan.goal: Collect logs and craft basic tools
plan.action_nl: Collect oak logs, craft planks, sticks, crafting table, and a wooden pickaxe.
plan.notes: Pickaxes need 3 iron ingots + 2 sticks. Collect extra logs for sticks and crafting table.

plan.goal: Mine cobblestone and craft stone pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Use the wooden pickaxe to mine cobblestone, then craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Stone pickaxe is REQUIRED to mine iron ore. Wooden pickaxe cannot harvest iron.

plan.action_nl: Mine iron ore, smelt into ingots, and craft iron sword and iron chestplate for protection.
plan.expected: Iron sword and iron chestplate in inventory.
plan.notes: Endermen are dangerous. Iron equipment is minimum recommended gear.

plan.action_nl: Search for endermen at night or in the End dimension.
plan.notes: Endermen spawn at night in the overworld. Do NOT look at them directly or they will attack.

plan.action_nl: Stand under the 2-block shelter and attack the enderman with iron sword.
plan.expected: Ender pearl dropped from defeated enderman.
plan.notes: Endermen drop 0-1 ender pearls when killed. May need to defeat multiple for enough pearls.

name: Collect Blaze Rods
rationale: Blaze rods are needed for brewing stands and eyes of ender to reach the End. Dropped by blazes in Nether fortresses.
actual: Craft a shield, enter the Nether, find a fortress, and defeat blazes to collect blaze rods.

plan.goal: Collect logs and craft basic tools
plan.action_nl: Collect oak logs, craft planks, sticks, crafting table, and a wooden pickaxe.
plan.notes: Full chain needed: wooden → stone → iron pickaxe before you can mine diamonds.

plan.goal: Mine cobblestone and craft stone pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Use wooden pickaxe to mine cobblestone, then craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Stone pickaxe is needed to mine iron ore.

plan.goal: Mine iron, smelt, and craft iron pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Mine 3 iron ore with stone pickaxe, smelt raw_iron into ingots, craft an iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Iron pickaxe is the minimum tool required to mine diamond ore. Mining iron_ore drops raw_iron in 1.17+.

plan.action_nl: Find and mine 3 diamond ore blocks deep underground (below Y=-58) using the iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Diamonds only spawn below Y=-58. You MUST use an iron pickaxe or better.

plan.action_nl: Use a Crafting Table to combine 3 diamonds and 2 sticks in a 'T' shape pattern.
plan.expected: A Diamond Pickaxe is added to your inventory.
plan.notes: Diamond Pickaxe can mine obsidian and is the fastest pickaxe tier before netherite.

plan.action_nl: Mine iron ore, smelt into an ingot, and craft a shield with planks.
plan.notes: Shield is critical for blocking blaze fireballs.

plan.goal: Build and ignite a Nether portal
plan.action_nl: Mine gravel for flint, smelt an iron ingot, craft flint and steel, mine obsidian, and light the portal
plan.notes: flint drops probabilistically from gravel; diamond pickaxe required to harvest obsidian

plan.action_nl: Search for nether bricks which indicate a fortress structure.
plan.notes: Nether fortresses contain blaze spawners. Look for dark nether brick structures.

plan.action_nl: Use shield to block fireballs and attack blazes with a weapon.
plan.expected: Blaze rods dropped from defeated blazes.
plan.notes: Blazes drop 0-1 blaze rods when killed by a player. Fire resistance potions help greatly.

name: Collect Nether Quartz
rationale: Nether quartz is used for redstone comparators, observers, and decorative blocks. Found only in the Nether.
actual: Enter the Nether through a portal and mine nether quartz ore. Requires access to obsidian for portal construction.

plan.goal: Craft stone pickaxe for nether mining
plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft sticks, mine cobblestone, and craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Nether quartz ore needs at least a stone pickaxe to mine.

plan.action_nl: Use a nether portal to enter the Nether dimension.
plan.notes: Need an active nether portal. Building one requires 10 obsidian and flint and steel.

plan.action_nl: Search in the Nether for nether quartz ore deposits.
plan.notes: Nether quartz ore is common in the Nether, appearing as white-speckled blocks in netherrack.

plan.action_nl: Mine at least 16 nether quartz ore blocks using stone pickaxe or better.
plan.notes: Each nether quartz ore drops exactly 1 quartz. Collect enough for redstone components.

name: Collect Flint
rationale: Flint is needed for flint and steel, arrows, and other items. It drops from gravel at ~10% chance per block, so you must mine many gravel blocks to reliably obtain it.
actual: Mine at least 20 gravel blocks to reliably get 1 or more flint (each block has 10% drop chance).

plan.goal: Craft a wooden shovel for faster gravel mining
plan.action_nl: Collect logs, craft planks, sticks, and a wooden shovel to mine gravel efficiently.
plan.notes: A shovel mines gravel faster but is optional — hands work too.

plan.goal: Mine at least 20 gravel blocks to collect flint
plan.action_nl: Gravel drops flint at approximately 10% chance per block. Mine 20 or more blocks to reliably obtain at least 1 flint.
plan.notes: Flint drop rate is ~10% per gravel block. Mining 20 blocks gives ~88% chance of getting at least 1 flint. Do NOT mine just 1-3 blocks — that rarely yields flint.
